title: Smooth cut-off of a sublevel set of a Lipschitz function, gradient ≤ L/(h(1 − h/2)) and supported in the strip {t − h < f < t}
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, L ≥ 0, f : ℝ^P → ℝ L-Lipschitz, t ∈ ℝ and 0 < h < 1. Then there is a C^∞ function g : ℝ^P → ℝ such that |g(x)| ≤ 2 for all x; ‖Dg(x)‖ ≤ L/(h(1 − h/2)) for all x (operator norm of fderiv ℝ g x); Dg(x) ≠ 0 implies t − h < f(x) < t; g(x) = 1 whenever f(x) ≤ t − h; and g(x) = 0 whenever f(x) ≥ t.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal) (t h : ℝ), LipschitzWith L f → 0 < h → h < 1 → ∃ g : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g ∧ (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ g x‖ ≤ L / (h * (1 - h / 2))) ∧ (∀ x, fderiv ℝ g x ≠ 0 → t - h < f x ∧ f x < t) ∧ (∀ x, f x ≤ t - h → g x = 1) ∧ (∀ x, t ≤ f x → g x = 0)
